venues.name: D&C DC
venues.notes_summary: **DC — Saturday 2/28.** Busy Saturday. Garden: slow start then picked up once Marquee filled; larger parties enjoying the weather; no barback so Josh swung out to support Jada and Khaleel helped behind the bar; Garden closed at midnight. D&C: room constantly sat; trouble ~9pm with hard turns and some serious campers; waitlist burned through by 11 then focus on Marquee. Comps include a full comp for a community member. Kitchen: nearly 11% of sales; popcorn 86'd before kitchen last call. MOD: Josh / Cory.

venues.name: D&C EV
venues.notes_summary: **EV — Saturday 2/28.** Line up the block at open on a very warm day; busy cadence throughout, with James and Seth's quick timing and mutual support on bar. Many checks hovering around $300, though most tables either ate or drank heavily, not both. 8 large parties, 4 solos, 6 investor cocktails; comps $238.95. Top sellers: Material Control, Masari, Jabalina, First Time Listener (tequila dominates). Door: bachelorette and birthday large tops launched the evening; parties of 3+ had long waits and many returned; twos often got one round for quicker turns; welcomed Frankie Loretta (DK's nephew) and a producer of Sinners; waitlist cleared ~12:30am; full house at close. No no-shows. Kitchen: great work solo, great family meal.
